physical_inference: Every consumer waiting for all transactions of its operand burst must join downstream return endpoints, including a cold segment after hits can return.
Byte-port occupancy is its transactions divided by physical capacity; return latency remains a consumer dependency, not additional port occupancy.
Independent buffered K panels each retain this return dependency; source buffer rings determine whether other work hides it.
no_new_parameter: Node unloaded latencies, service capacities and transaction geometry all come from existing HWSpec/MemoryDiagnostics; no sampled body duration prices Forward.
transfer_limits: The capture proves dependency semantics, not exact native per-cycle CTA fairness, launch placement, compiler issue timing or complete GEMM latency.
Per-stage downstream requests inherit aggregate cache ratios; sub-transaction node demand is a fluid expected-cardinality approximation, not an observed panel cache event.
The existing equal resident-lane capacity approximation remains; source-expanded fluid arbitration is still not adopted.
